## 5. Sensitivity to the two unverified labelling assumptions

Each cell: Deletion Completeness / False-delete count / Exception handling accuracy, after re-labelling the gold set as the scenario says.

| Scenario | Baseline (raw by filename) | PoC, machine only | PoC + human review | V1 inherit_hold = false |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S0 gold as labelled (A1 + A3 hold) | 0.073 / 2 / 0.000 | 0.927 / 0 / 1.000 | 1.000 / 0 / 1.000 | 0.927 / 26 / 0.458 |
| S1 hold NOT inherited (26 pairs become delete) | 0.059 / 2 / 0.000 | 0.750 / 0 / 1.000 | 0.809 / 0 / 1.000 | 0.941 / 0 / 1.000 |
| S2 shared-by-all stays escalate (8 pairs become escalate) | 0.078 / 2 / 0.000 | 1.000 / 0 / 1.000 | 1.000 / 8 / 0.857 | 1.000 / 26 / 0.536 |
| S3 = S1 + S2 | 0.062 / 2 / 0.000 | 0.797 / 0 / 1.000 | 0.797 / 8 / 0.733 | 1.000 / 0 / 1.000 |

Reading guide: a False-delete count above 0 means data that should have been kept was destroyed, which cannot be undone; a completeness below 1 means a deletion is still owed and can be done later.
